body:
#2744 is still RED at 31630ba433: same SHA and same CI run (39275684356) as your report. The CI-fix brief I mailed after that report hasn't been applied yet. Two changes, then push:

1. REMOVE `.current_dir(home.path())` from run_path_isolated_test_output in aida-cli-lib/src/test_env.rs (~line 64). It sets the isolated child's cwd to a temp HOME that isn't a git repo, which makes 24 regen::score tests panic: "git worktree list --porcelain -z failed (exit status: 128): fatal: not a git repository". Main doesn't have this line. Verify with: AIDA_CARGO_TIMEOUT=900 cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib regen::score (it must pass), plus your test_env and task_1507 filters.
2. Revert your aida-cli-lib/src/agent_launch.rs and session_end.rs #[cfg(test)] skip_process_chdir branches, if they're still in the diff. Test-only branching in production launch code is out of scope for this PR.
3. TRAILER. The title and commit end in "(BUG-2118)", and the trailing parenthesized ID AUTO-COMPLETES that spec at merge, the opposite of "does not close it". Retitle the PR to end in (TASK-1970), which I just filed to own this PR: `[AI:antigravity] test(fixtures): cwd-scanner fn-reset fix and fixture cwd hygiene (TASK-1970)`. Put the same trailer on your new commit; keep "Refs BUG-2118" in the body.
4. Merge origin/main (you're 6 behind; #2754 changed ci.yml).

Gate: cargo fmt --all; make check-ci-fast; the targeted filters above; make check-ci-compile. Push, reply with the SHA, and don't merge or ship. The re-review is scoped to these changes.
subject: #2744 still RED at 31630ba433: remove current_dir(home), retitle to TASK-1970
